description: Use this when someone asks about a listed company's earnings calls or other investor calls: when the next one is, or its latest and past calls. Give it the company's ticker or name. Returns upcoming calls first, then past calls newest first with their replay on 6ix.com, fiscal quarter and whether the call's text can be read with get_earnings_call_transcript, and how many upcoming and past calls 6ix lists; pass the answer's nextCursor as cursor to go further back.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

include_past.description: Also list past calls with replays

page.description: Page 2 and on go further back in time

name: get_company_earnings_calls

fiscalPeriod.description: Fiscal quarter the results call covers, e.g. Q2 2026

transcript.description: The call's text can be read with get_earnings_call_transcript

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

pastTotal.description: Past calls 6ix lists for the company (0 when include_past is false)

upcomingTotal.description: Upcoming calls 6ix lists for the company

title: Earnings calls from a company
